story: Stage 1 began with an early attack from Victor Campenaerts. A seven-rider breakaway formed, with Josh Burnett and Dylan Vandenstorme the last to be caught. The stage ended in a mass sprint, where Christophe Laporte beat Bastien Tronchon to take the winand the first place in the GC.
